name: Stone Wall
primary:
A wall against arrows, or look up for a tent against attacks from the sky.
A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description: A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: magic earth, permanent. No extra effects.
